Combats au tour par tour entre les créat: Turn-based fights between NeoBestiary Studio creatures, against the computer or two players on the same PC. Each creature has 2 to 4 moves drawn from 204 techniques: statuses (burn, poison, freeze, sleep, paralysis…), stat stages, accuracy, multi-hit moves, life steal, heals and boosts, with a type chart from ×4 to ×¼. Guard, colour variants, a win record, and NeoMe with its signature moves. New: teams of 3, with switches during the fight (the computer also knows when to switch out of danger). Each creature has a passive talent (Rage, Shell, Scout, Regeneration…), and Draft mode has both sides pick 3 creatures in turn from 9. Hits are seen and heard: a sound for each move type and element, the target recoils and flashes white, guarding makes it crouch, statuses show on the body (burn, freeze, poison, sleep), and epic or legendary moves get their own staging.
